summary: Tolsma-Grisnich is a Dutch maker of storage technology and handling equipment for potatoes, onions and carrots, based in Emmeloord. Its machines cover ventilation, refrigeration, climate control, intake, cleaning, washing, grading and optical sorting. It describes itself as an international family business; Tolsma began developing potato storage devices in 1952.
founded: 1966 (basis of current company; potato storage devices from 1952)
machines: Fans and Air Control MAX: storage ventilation units developed and produced in-house
Fresh Box: refreshes storage air to remove CO2
Quadro Compact Cooler (QCC): refrigeration unit for crop stores
Vision Control: storage computer for temperature, humidity and CO2
YOU (Yield Observation Unit): measures product weight in the bulk pile
Desoiler unit: dry soil remover, inline or stand-alone
Stone, clod and haulm separator: water-stream bath removing stones, clods and haulm
TG-W washer: drum washer with automatic water level and sludge detection
MV 09, MV 13, MV 18: shake sorters with five independently driven decks
Optica S and Optica Q: optical sorters for intake defects and seed potato quality
facts: Acquired Becom in 2005 and Grisnich in 2007, then became Tolsma-Grisnich
Full ownership of Farm Electronics (Grantham, UK) from 1 January 2019
Acquired rights to Swiss stone and clod separator maker Samro in 2012
Optica Q: 15 to 18 tons of seed potatoes checked per hour
German washing project: three lines, 70 t/h nominal and 100 t/h peak per line
